title: Extend chat database models with relationship and character tables
description:
Extend chatbot/db/models.py with SQLAlchemy models for relationship configuration and character profile persistence.

Add a RelationshipConfigModel table with columns:
- id: primary key
- session_id: foreign key or association to the session
- type: str (friend, mentor, peer, partner, custom)
- tone: str
- directness: float
- warmth: float
- initiative_level: float
- content_level: str
- created_at: timestamp
- updated_at: timestamp

Add a CharacterProfileModel table with columns:
- id: primary key
- session_id: foreign key or association
- name: str
- backstory: text
- personality_sliders: JSON column (stores dict)
- humor_style: str
- communication_style: str
- favorite_topics: JSON column (stores list of strings)
- created_at: timestamp
- updated_at: timestamp

Add an IdentityStateModel table with columns:
- id: primary key
- session_id: foreign key or association
- fixed: JSON column (immutable traits)
- slow: JSON column (slowly-evolving traits)
- mood: JSON column (temporary mood)
- last_updated: timestamp

Use the existing session model's foreign key relationship pattern. Follow the table naming conventions and column types already in use in chatbot/db/models.py.

Expected file path: chatbot/db/models.py (modified)

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docs/architecture.md
- chatbot/db/models.py (existing models, session table, foreign key patterns, import conventions)
- chatbot/soul/relationship.py
- chatbot/soul/character.py
- chatbot/soul/evolution.py

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
acceptance_criteria: chatbot/db/models.py contains RelationshipConfigModel, CharacterProfileModel, and IdentityStateModel SQLAlchemy tables
RelationshipConfigModel has columns: type, tone, directness, warmth, initiative_level, content_level
CharacterProfileModel has columns: name, backstory, personality_sliders, humor_style, communication_style, favorite_topics
IdentityStateModel has columns: fixed, slow, mood
New models follow existing session foreign key and import patterns in the file
No file outside chatbot/db/models.py is created or modified
No existing tables or columns in models.py are deleted or renamed
